name: ideaswork
description: Use platform capabilities, run published Skills, and build reusable IdeasWork Skills locally in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Use APIs, run and build Skills
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to IdeasWork so you can use platform capabilities, discover and run published Skills, and turn successful workflows into reusable Skills with Remote MCP platform tools, standard OAuth, and the local Runtime Core installed from the matching npm package. The plugin registers one Remote MCP tool source; it does not launch a local platform MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Show me the IdeasWork Skills I can use.
Generate an image of a cat astronaut with IdeasWork.
Make a short video ad about a coffee brand with IdeasWork.
